#{skuCode}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO sku_stock_projection (sku_code, sellable_quantity, inventory_version, source_updated_at, synced_at) VALUES (#{skuCode}, #{sellableQuantity}, #{inventoryVersion}, #{sourceUpdatedAt}, NOW()) ON CONFLICT (sku_code) DO UPDATE SET sellable_quantity = EXCLUDED.sellable_quantity, inventory_version = EXCLUDED.inventory_version, source_updated_at = EXCLUDED.source_updated_at, synced_at = NOW() WHERE EXCLUDED.inventory_version > sku_stock_projection.inventory_version
mapper.select:
SELECT ssp.sku_code, ssp.sellable_quantity, ssp.inventory_version, ssp.source_updated_at, ssp.synced_at, COUNT(pv.id) AS linked_variant_count FROM sku_stock_projection ssp LEFT JOIN product_variants pv ON COALESCE(NULLIF(BTRIM(pv.inventory_sku_code), ''), pv.sku_code) = ssp.sku_code
AND ssp.sku_code ILIKE CONCAT('%', #{q}, '%')
GROUP BY ssp.sku_code, ssp.sellable_quantity, ssp.inventory_version, ssp.source_updated_at, ssp.synced_at
HAVING COUNT(pv.id) > 0
HAVING COUNT(pv.id) = 0
ORDER BY ssp.synced_at DESC, ssp.sku_code ASC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ( SELECT ssp.sku_code FROM sku_stock_projection ssp LEFT JOIN product_variants pv ON COALESCE(NULLIF(BTRIM(pv.inventory_sku_code), ''), pv.sku_code) = ssp.sku_code
AND ssp.sku_code ILIKE CONCAT('%', #{q}, '%')
GROUP BY ssp.sku_code
HAVING COUNT(pv.id) > 0
HAVING COUNT(pv.id) = 0
) filtered
